Clarification to [SWS_EcuM_04033]: EcuM shall assume that the EcuM_ErrorHook

responsibility to define a strategy to handle it (e.g.: As EcuM does not directly call Dem,
set the Dem error after a reset recovery).
[SWS_EcuM_04139]
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00386
⌈If an OS function call returns an error code (other than E_OK), the EcuM shall call
EcuM_ErrorHook with error code ECUM_E_OS_CALL_FAILED.⌋
